name: System X
goal: The implemented urban design, ikebana, and graphic design probes, including their material interactions and generation pipelines.
description: A multi-touch design interface that turns gestures on digital elastic bands, clay, magnets, and sand into constraints for AI-generated visual designs. Its probes support urban layouts, flower arrangements, and graphic posters. Actors: model_1 = diffusion model with ControlNet Depth and Scribble conditioning and LayerDiffuse transparency support; model_2 = language model; tool_1 = physics engine; tool_2 = 3D rendering library; tool_3 = application preprocessing and postprocessing pipeline.

processes.name: Urban neighborhood design
processes.description: Starting with a site, the user draws elastic zoning boundaries, reshapes building density as clay, and positions function magnets. The application converts zones into a template-based 3D city, renders density edits with depth-conditioned model_1, and inpaints functions into the nearest blocks; bands and magnets enforce bounds and compatibility as the user moves them.
processes.rawExpression:
(urban_site_1: artifact spatial)
-> [human specify]
-> (urban_site_1: artifact spatial) + (zoning_bands_1: instruction spatial)*
-> [tool_1 modify]
-> (zoning_bands_2: instruction spatial)*
-> [tool_3 compose]
-> (urban_plan_1: artifact spatial)
-> [tool_2 translate]
-> (city_model_1: artifact spatial)
-> [tool_3 translate]
-> (city_model_1: artifact spatial) + (density_grid_1: instruction spatial)
-> [human modify]
-> (city_model_1: artifact spatial) + (density_grid_2: instruction spatial)
-> [tool_2 modify]
-> (city_model_2: artifact spatial)
-> [tool_3 translate]
-> (depth_map_1: artifact visual)
-> [model_1 generate]~
-> (render_1: artifact visual)
-> [human specify]
-> (render_1: artifact visual) + (function_magnets_1: instruction spatial)*
-> [tool_1 modify]
-> (render_1: artifact visual) + (function_magnets_2: instruction spatial)*
-> [tool_3 translate]
-> (render_1: artifact visual) + (inpainting_masks_1: selection spatial)* + (function_prompts_1: instruction language)*
-> [model_1 modify]~
-> (render_2: artifact visual)

processes.name: Ikebana flower arrangement
processes.description: The user positions magnetic circles for the three main flower-arrangement elements and can add flowers or leaves. The magnetic interface enforces spatial and proportional rules, then converts the arrangement to scribble conditioning for model_1 to generate a flower image.
processes.rawExpression:
(ikebana_canvas_1: artifact spatial)
-> [human specify]
-> (ikebana_elements_1: instruction spatial)*
-> [tool_1 modify]
-> (ikebana_elements_2: instruction spatial)*
-> [tool_3 translate]
-> (scribble_map_1: artifact visual) + (ikebana_prompt_1: instruction language)
-> [model_1 generate]~
-> (ikebana_image_1: artifact visual)

processes.name: Graphic poster design
processes.description: Starting with a design theme and square canvas, the user adds and reshapes sand clusters and labels their roles by voice. Cluster size and density control the output: model_2 generates text, model_1 generates transparent imagery, and the application assembles them into a poster.
processes.rawExpression:
(poster_theme_1: instruction language) + (poster_canvas_1: artifact spatial)
-> [human specify]
-> (poster_theme_1: instruction language) + (sand_clusters_1: instruction spatial)*
-> [human modify]
-> (poster_theme_1: instruction language) + (sand_clusters_2: instruction spatial)*
-> [human specify]
-> (poster_theme_1: instruction language) + (sand_clusters_2: instruction spatial)* + (spoken_roles_1: instruction audio)*
-> [tool_3 translate]
-> (poster_theme_1: instruction language) + (sand_clusters_2: instruction spatial)* + (element_roles_1: label categorical)*
-> [tool_3 compose]
-> (poster_theme_1: instruction language) + (element_specs_1: instruction record)*
-> [model_2 generate]~
-> (element_specs_1: instruction record)* + (text_elements_1: artifact language)*
-> [model_1 generate]~
-> (element_specs_1: instruction record)* + (text_elements_1: artifact language)* + (image_elements_1: artifact visual)*
-> [tool_3 compose]
-> (poster_1: artifact visual)

representations.urban_site: the empty site the user plans a neighborhood on
representations.zoning_bands: elastic bands the user draws to mark zone boundaries
representations.urban_plan: the zones and blocks of the neighborhood
representations.city_model: a simple 3D city built from templates for each zone
representations.density_grid: building density the user shapes like clay
representations.depth_map: a depth image of the 3D city
representations.render: a generated image of the neighborhood
representations.function_magnets: magnets that mark functions such as a park or school, which attract or repel each other
representations.inpainting_masks: the blocks nearest each magnet, to be repainted
representations.function_prompts: text describing each function for repainting
representations.ikebana_canvas: the canvas for a flower arrangement
representations.ikebana_elements: magnetic circles for the main flowers and leaves, kept in proportion by the interface
representations.scribble_map: a line drawing of the arrangement
representations.sand_clusters: clusters of sand the user adds and reshapes; their size and density set an element's size and weight
representations.spoken_roles: the user's spoken labels for what each cluster is, such as title or image
representations.element_specs: each element's role, position, size and content request
